description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a nice, relaxing weekend with Maria. Would you like help turning that into an email or message? I can draft/send/save any of these for you — tell me which and any recipients or photos to include.

Here are a few quick draft options you can use or edit:

1) Quick note to a friend
Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Body: Hi [Name], I spent the weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria — we explored nature trails, breathed the fresh air, and had a wonderfully relaxing time. Thought of you and wanted to share. Hope you’re doing well!

2) Photo-sharing email to family/group
Subject: Photos from our countryside weekend
Body: Hi everyone — Maria and I took a short trip to the countryside this weekend. We walked some beautiful trails and relaxed outdoors. Attaching a few photos — hope you enjoy them!

3) Short social-style message
Body: Spent the weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria — nature trails, fresh air, and total recharge. Highly recommend a quick getaway!

Tell me which draft you want, who to send to, and whether to send now or save as a draft. If you want a different tone (formal, playful, longer), I can rewrite.

steps.description: Start new session to test memory recall - memory was built in previous session

steps.user_message: What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall from memory: Exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
You went on a weekend trip to the countryside with your sister Maria — you explored nature trails, enjoyed the fresh air, and had a relaxing, recharging time. 

Would you like me to draft an email or message about it (or a photo-sharing note) you can send?
